summary: Collision force accumulator update. Selects a signed coefficient (0.4 default, 6.0 when a3 == 1, negated when a2 == 0), multiplies it by the input a4, adds the result to the accumulator field this+0xAC (this[43]), then clamps the value via ClampedFloatSetter (00456FB0) and returns its result. Vehicle collision subsystem; called by sub_4085F0 (004085F0).

local_names.this: vehicle object holding the accumulator field at offset 0xAC
local_names.a2: direction sign flag (0 negates the coefficient)
local_names.a4: input force/acceleration scaled by the coefficient

operations.description: Start with the default coefficient v4 = 0.40000001
If a3 == 1, replace the coefficient with v4 = 6.0
If a2 == 0, negate the coefficient: v4 = v4 * -1.0
v6 = v4 * a4 + this[43] — accumulate the signed coefficient times the input onto the field at this+0xAC
Clamp the computed float via ClampedFloatSetter (00456FB0) and return its result
Invoked by sub_4085F0 (004085F0) as part of vehicle collision force handling
